title: Settlement Relationship Points and the Borrower's Other Personal Loan
content:
For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a borrower whose other active Larkspur personal loan has no amount past due earns 5 points; a borrower whose other active loan has an amount past due and a next due date fewer than 30 calendar days before the decision date earns 2 points; a borrower with no other active loan, or one 30 or more days past due, earns none, the borrower's other active loan being a single loan, because Larkspur lets a borrower hold at most two open personal loans at a time and takes no new loan application while any of the borrower's loans is charged off. Each point is one percentage point off the settlement percentage.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which loan is looked at?** The borrower's other Personal Loans loan in active status — the charged-off loan being settled is not active.

**What earns 5 points?** That active loan showing no amount past due on its record.

**What earns 2 points?** That active loan showing an amount past due with a next due date fewer than 30 calendar days before the decision date.

**What earns none?** No other active loan, or an other active loan past due with a next due date 30 or more calendar days before the decision date.

*Hypothetical boundary, decision on 31 May:* other loan past due with next due date 2 May (29 days before) earns 2 points; with next due date 1 May (30 days before) it earns none.
